_validate_required_params_service_role expects wrong string format
I installed moto with `pip install moto` and I'm using version 4.1.10.

The unit test below is currently commented out in [my project](https://github.com/uktrade/copilot-tools/blob/main/tests/test_codebuild_cli.py#L193), but, when I uncomment and run, it errors with `InvalidInputException("An error occurred (InvalidInputException) when calling the CreateProject operation: Invalid service role: Service role account ID does not match caller's account"`. (I don't get any more traceback than that). I would expect a successful 200 response and for the project to be created with this role.

```
@patch("commands.codebuild_cli.check_github_conn")
@mock_sts
@mock_iam
@mock_codebuild
def test_codedeploy(check_github_conn, aws_credentials):
    session = boto3.session.Session()
    session.client("iam").create_account_alias(AccountAlias="foo")
    runner = CliRunner()
    runner.invoke(create_codedeploy_role, ["--project-profile", "foo"])
    result = runner.invoke(codedeploy, ["--name", "unit-test-project", "--git", "https://github.com/uktrade/not-a-real-repo", "--branch", "main", "--buildspec", "./buildspec.yml", "--project-profile", "foo" ])

    assert "Codebuild project unit-test-project created" in result.output
```

There are [instructions](https://github.com/uktrade/copilot-tools/blob/main/README.md) for setting up the project and running the test in full, but the crux of the issue is that I'm calling the boto `client("codebuild").create_project() ` method with `serviceRole="arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-CodeBuild-role"` . The error is raised by [this method](https://github.com/getmoto/moto/blob/master/moto/codebuild/responses.py#L32) in moto/codebuild/responses:

```
def _validate_required_params_service_role(account_id: str, service_role: str) -> None:
    if f"arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/service-role/" not in service_role:
        raise InvalidInputException(
            "Invalid service role: Service role account ID does not match caller's account"
        )
```
I believe that it's a bug to require the service role arn to end with "service-role". When I create a service role through the AWS console, it doesn't end with "service-role". Moreover, it is not possible to create a linked service role, as [codebuild does not support these](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_aws-services-that-work-with-iam.html). Even if it were, the arn would end with `aws-service-role`, not `service-role`.
